lines.en: I drift along, my robe never touching ground.
The book in my hands turns its own pages.
I drift along the trail of blood.

lines.zh: 我去找一个值得附魔的家伙。
lines.en: I go looking for someone worth enchanting.
Specks of light follow me as I move.

lines.zh: 我的影子有三道，其实只有一具。
lines.en: My shadow splits in three; I am only one.

lines.zh: 我在灰烬上走过去，不发热。
lines.en: I cross the ashes without warmth.

lines.zh: 书页上的字在我身侧旋转。
lines.en: The words on the page orbit me.
I process along the wall's base.

lines.zh: 我的脚步听不见，只有书响。
lines.en: No footsteps, only the book's rustle.

lines.zh: 我从一个书架走到另一个。
lines.en: I go from one shelf to the next.

lines.zh: 我的袖口流出细细的光。
lines.en: Thin light spills from my cuffs.
I raise a hand with a page between my fingers.
I move slowly up the village lane.

lines.zh: 我找的是已经打过一场的人。
lines.en: I seek someone who has already fought.
I go around the fields to avoid trampling them.
I'm waiting for a raid.
The wind won't touch me as I pass.
I stop; the book hangs at my side.

lines.zh: 我在读一段没人写过的文字。
lines.en: I read a passage no one wrote.

lines.zh: 我的指间转着一枚符文。
lines.en: A rune turns between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把这本书翻到最后一页。
lines.en: I turn this book to its final page.
The people here are worth strengthening.
I belong to no side.

lines.zh: 风把我的袍角吹开又合上。
lines.en: The wind parts my robe and closes it.

lines.zh: 我在数这支袭击队还缺谁。
lines.en: I count who's missing from this raiding party.
A halo floats above my head.
I raise a hand and the light withdraws into my sleeve.
The book closes itself.

lines.zh: 我记得每个被强化过的名字。
lines.en: I remember every name I strengthened.
You carry unwritten runes.
Let me see if you're worth writing on.
There's old light on your sword.
Don't fear; I don't strike people.
Have you been strengthened?

lines.zh: 我能让你的敌人更难过。
lines.en: I can make your enemies harder to face.

lines.zh: 你手里的书，和我这本不一样。
lines.en: Your book is not like mine.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，书也在看。
lines.en: While I look at you, the book looks too.
Stand still and let me read.

lines.zh: 我在你的名字边上留了空。
lines.en: I've left a space beside your name.
A few pages scatter.
My light dims a shade.
My scraps of paper drift back into place.
You've scattered the writing.
Half of me goes transparent.
Now I must copy it out again.
I have no blood, yet I feel pain.
A joint of light breaks off my finger.
That blow tore one of my lines.
I remember you. You'll be written.
Books don't eat.
I've no use for what you hold.
My nourishment is other people's blood.
Put it away; it isn't done.
Bribing an enchanter?

lines.zh: 我抬手，你的东西飘了一下。
lines.en: I raise a hand and your offering floats.

lines.zh: 那点东西，连一页都换不来。
lines.en: That won't buy even one page.
I won't take it, and I bear no grudge.
Keep it; you'll need it on the road.
I smile, and the pages turn.
You hit me and pass partly through.
I'm not solid; don't push.
You step back; half a page falls.
My robe lifts with your movement.
Touch me and you'll feel cold.
I drift a step aside. I won't contest it.
A page circles you once.
You're not hurt, and neither am I.
When I steady, the light scatters.
Don't step on my book.

lines.zh: 另一位附魔师也在这里。
lines.en: Another enchanter is here too.
Our books page against page.
We exchange a rune.
Fellow enchanters need no pleasantries.
What it wrote is crueler than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把名字记在各自的页边。
lines.en: We note names in each other's margins.
When this one's done, we part.
It nods; its book shuts.
We never write on each other.

lines.zh: 下次见面，也许各在一方。
lines.en: Next time we may stand on different sides.
I dip my head; the book carries it for me.
I gather up the words that fell.
It falls into my sleeve.
There's old writing on this.
I turn it over, look, and stow it.
This pearl could serve as ink.

lines.zh: 我没有手去拿，书替我拿。
lines.en: I don't use hands; the book takes it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，都有一点光。
lines.en: Everything on the ground has a little light.
I slip it between pages seven.
Stowed. We go on.
That one over there is worth a line.
I raise a hand; a rune flies out.
I'll add something to your people.
Don't thank me; it's an experiment.
Whoever you're fighting will grow stronger.
The name is written.
I used red ink for this page.

lines.zh: 你还没发现身上多了什么。
lines.en: You haven't noticed what's on you now.
Let's make this fight livelier.
I've fixed on that one.
When I raise my hand, the wind pauses.
You'd best finish quickly.
It carries the light now.
I'm looking for the next one.
I wrote on that one's armor.
The pages are still turning. Wait.
I stay at the rear, watching.
Whoever bleeds most, I mark.

lines.zh: 我飘到另一边，避开你们的混战。
lines.en: I drift to the other side, clear of the melee.

lines.zh: 我看见它被你们压住了。
lines.en: I see it's pinned under you.
I added a line for it.
I'm not done writing.

lines.zh: 我的书翻到那一页就停。
lines.en: My book stops on that page.
I've noted this thread.
I raise a hand; a shaft of light stabs out.

lines.zh: 这一下没有伤口，只有字。
lines.en: That leaves no wound, only writing.
I wrote your name crooked.
A page slices your sleeve.
I cut you with a page.
Light coils around your ankle.
This stroke will ache a while.

lines.zh: 你退开，字还是落在你身上。
lines.en: Step back; the writing still lands.
I write quickly.
You're on this page now.
The book lands first; then I appear.

lines.zh: 我从一页空白里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of a blank page.
The halo rises. I've arrived.
The hands here are suited to writing.
I open to the first page.
The wind blows ash into a line of script.
I look over this raiding party.
They could use a little help.
I settle down beside the altar.

lines.zh: 我的袍角先出现，然后才是脸。
lines.en: My hem appears first, then my face.
This page begins today.
I hear someone reciting an incantation.

lines.zh: 火燎过书页，字烧掉一半。
lines.en: Fire licks the page; half the words char.

lines.zh: 我落下来，散成一片墨点。
lines.en: I fall and scatter into ink drops.
The paper soaks and the words begin to run.
The blast flips my book shut.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉在后面的树上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me into a tree.

lines.zh: 另一段咒文压住了我的。
lines.en: Another incantation overrides mine.

lines.zh: 没有血可读，我越来越淡。
lines.en: No blood to read; I grow fainter.
Lightning whites out the whole page.

lines.zh: 我一直往下掉，字也散了。
lines.en: I fall, and the writing comes apart.
